apps.name: BCD
apps.subtitle: Windows games on iPhone and iPad
apps.localizedDescription: A fast, controller-friendly launcher that runs Windows games on iOS and iPadOS with Steam and GOG built in, powered by Wine, FEX and Metal via DXMT.

versions.localizedDescription:
**BCD is in alpha:** an early stage of development, before beta. Many games run, many do not yet, and things can break between builds. When a game fails, please send a log.

> **Tried one of these games on an earlier build? Reset its settings first.** A game keeps the settings it had until you reset them, so without this it may start with the old ones that failed. On the game's page: **Options › Recommended settings › Reset to Recommended**, then check that **Options › Auto-tune › Auto-tune this game** is on, and start the game again.

This build fixes failures found in the logs you sent with Send Log since 0.1.578. Each fix targets the error a log showed; none of them could be tested on a device yet, so a game may now get further and still stop at a later point. If it does, please send a new log: it names the next problem.

- **Counter-Strike 2:** after it ran once, later starts could stay on "Steam is installing content this game needs" for good. Steam was waiting for its package of Windows redistributables, which BCD does not need to install; BCD now starts the game without that wait.
- **Steam games that crash:** when a game started with BCD Dock crashed, its window could stay on screen as if it were frozen or opened in a tiny window (Dying Light, The Binding of Isaac). BCD now ends the session and says which error the game closed with, and auto-tune can act on it at the next start.
- **Grand Theft Auto IV:** the main menu could show broken shapes when the game's 32-bit memory space was full. BCD now waits for the graphics work to finish instead of drawing old data. Short hitches in play can still happen: they come from the same full memory space.
- **Diablo II: Resurrected:** stopped at start because two Windows files it imports were missing. Its recommended settings now give it Wine's versions. It still stops later during start-up; that part is being looked at.
- **Batman: Arkham City:** now gets past its earlier crash (auto-tune's floating-point attempt) to its launcher, which stops inside Wine Mono. Auto-tune tries a fix for that after the crash, and the log names the cause either way.
- **Library entries that run a .bat or .cmd file** no longer stop before the file runs.
- **.NET Framework programs built for "Any CPU"** (for example The Dishwasher: Vampire Smile) now start with Wine Mono instead of stopping at once. Wine Mono is in Settings › .NET Framework.
- **One-time installs:** a DirectX setup that failed is not run again: BCD provides those libraries itself. Installs that never started are offered once more instead of being skipped (Grand Theft Auto V).
- **Steam games started without Steam:** a game that needs Steam and was started directly now says so and points to BCD Dock (Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter, Katana ZERO).
- **32-bit games that cannot get their memory window** no longer leave BCD showing the game as running for minutes (Tomb Raider: Underworld).
- **.NET 6 and later games** that stopped with "GC heap initialization failed" (Unrailed! 2): auto-tune and the game's recommended settings now limit how much address space .NET reserves.
- **Recommended settings for more games:** Clair Obscur: Expedition 33, Grand Theft Auto IV, Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas – The Definitive Edition, Unrailed! 2, and updated lists for the Stellar Blade demo, the FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE demo and Spelunky 2, also through the online list.
- **Auto-tune** no longer blames a game for a one-time installer's failure, for a session that only ran the installs, or for a message the game showed itself before it exited, and it can now add one more Windows file some games' Xbox libraries import.
- **Updates:** BCD now says, at most once a day, when a newer version is out: a small note with OK, nothing is blocked.
- **Memory limit:** an install without the increased memory limit is now told once, and again before a log is sent: large games close early there, small ones can still run.
- **New icon:** BCD has a new app icon.
- **Send Log:** logs name more causes (a thread that spins without progress, refused memory placements on older devices, the display paths a game reads, why a one-time install was skipped), so the next reports lead to fixes faster.

Install help, game reports and ideas: the BCD-Games Discord is open, https://discord.gg/43TmupTVug

**BCD.ipa**: the unsigned IPA, for sideloading with SideStore, AltStore or LiveContainer. It needs iOS 18 or later and JIT; the README has the details.
**BCD-source.tar.xz**: the complete source of this build with all its submodules (GPL-3.0).
